purpose: One day of an ActivityHeatmap: a small square shaded by its activity level from 0 to 5. It also serves as the swatch in the heatmap's legend.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside an ActivityHeatmap.
A colour swatch for categorical series.
A status dot on a person or object.

Default.visual: The fill of its Value only.

Focused.visual: A 2 px ring in Border/ring/default 1 px off the square; the fill does not change.

a11y.keyboard: Moved to by the heatmap's arrow keys; the cell itself has no keys of its own.
notes: Named by aria-label ("Tuesday, March 18: 8 contributions"); as a legend swatch it is role="presentation".
The ring colour changes with the motion role use-focus (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: The cell is a 12 px square, under the 24 px target. Is the keyboard grid plus the named cells enough, or does the pointer target need to grow?
Contrast: must neighbouring Chart/sequential levels, and level 1 against the page, meet a non-text contrast ratio, given that the level is also in the accessible name?
Reduced motion: should the focus ring appear with no fade (use-focus)?
The contract has no Figma set linked (finding DOC-001, codeOnly). Should it be added?
